text:
Asha (Account Exec): Heads up: SolarPath called about a $1,200 charge on their Apr invoice. They say it was for a POC that was supposed to be on sandbox but hit prod. Asking for goodwill refund.
Tom (Support): copy of customer note: "We accidentally pointed traffic at prod during a spike window on 2026-04-12. We own the mistake but this was a new integration test and cost us materially. Any chance of a one-time credit?"
Maria (Finance): can you paste invoice lines and timing?
Tom (Support): Invoice INV-2026-04-SP: usage.gen.tokens $1,180.00; support addon $20.00; total $1,200.00. Charge date 2026-04-13.
Jamal (Billing Ops): pulled request logs. There was a burst of requests between 2026-04-12T18:10Z and 18:47Z. No duplicated request_ids. This appears to be genuine prod traffic, ~2.95M tokens.
Maria (Finance): policy: goodwill credits < $2k can be approved by finance manager. Is this customer on enterprise contract?
Asha (Account Exec): they are on Growth plan, annual, but long-term partner. They've been vocal advocates. We should consider goodwill to keep them happy.
Maria (Finance): propose partial goodwill: credit 50% of the usage $590.00. Rationale: customer admitted mistake; we still want to preserve relationship. Jamal, confirm accounting impact.
Jamal (Billing Ops): if we issue $590 credit memo, GL: DR Promo Expense 5302 $590 / CR Accounts Receivable 1200 $590. I can create credit memo in Stripe and attach convo.
Tom (Support): customer reply: "Appreciate that. If you can do $600 credit that would be perfect."
Maria (Finance): fine to round to $600 for goodwill. Need manager approval. @Cecilia (Finance Manager) please approve $600 goodwill credit.
billing-bot: Credit request created: CR-9934 awaiting approval.
Cecilia (Finance Manager): approving $600 goodwill credit. Approved.
Jamal (Billing Ops): created Stripe credit memo CM_20260413_9934 for $600, applied to account. Journal entry queued.
billing-bot: Stripe operation successful  credit memo CM_20260413_9934 applied.
Asha (Account Exec): customer confirmed receipt and said "Thank you, that solved it. We'll add a workspace-level guardrail to prevent prod pointing during POC."
Maria (Finance): closing. Noting action: add playbook for POC onboarding guidance and update customer success checklist.
